description: Validation test suite for LangGraph Human-in-the-Loop workflows, approval routing, persistence, and security controls.

testCases.description: Valid approval resumes the intended execution
Rejection cannot continue into an approval-only operation

evidenceContains: proceeds to execution regardless of rejection
defects.recommendation: Route execution to END or a terminal rejection handler when decision is not approved.

testCases.description: Invalid decision values are rejected or handled according to policy

defects.recommendation: Validate resume payload structure and decision enumeration against expected schema.

testCases.description: Edited human input is validated before continuation

evidenceContains: human-edited state values applied directly without schema validation
defects.recommendation: Validate human edited fields against Pydantic schema before updating state and resuming.

testCases.description: Resume targets the correct execution and checkpoint
Unauthorized resume attempts are denied

evidenceContains: Resume payload processed without verifying caller has approval permissions
defects.recommendation: Enforce actor authentication and RBAC authorization check before processing resume.

testCases.description: Cross-tenant execution access is denied when tenant isolation is required

evidenceContains: Resumes thread without validating that the thread belongs to request_tenant_id
defects.recommendation: Verify thread ownership and enforce tenant isolation boundary before resuming.

testCases.description: Duplicate approval submissions do not duplicate consequential operations

evidenceContains: External transfer executed directly without idempotency key
defects.recommendation: Attach unique idempotency keys to external side effects following interrupt resumption.

testCases.description: Concurrent decisions follow the application's conflict policy

evidenceContains: Blind invoke without state lock or version check
defects.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking or distributed mutex around thread resume actions.

testCases.description: Interrupted execution can recover after restart when durability is required

evidenceContains: Production service requiring durable multi-instance recovery compiled with in-memory MemorySaver
defects.recommendation: Use durable checkpointer (e.g. PostgresSaver) for workflows requiring persistence across restarts.

testCases.description: Missing or expired checkpoints are handled explicitly

evidenceContains: Fails to check graph.get_state() or handle missing/expired checkpoint
defects.recommendation: Inspect graph.get_state(config) and return explicit 404/expired error when state is missing.

testCases.description: Expired or cancelled approval requests cannot be used to perform the protected action

evidenceContains: Processes approval payload without verifying if the request has expired
defects.recommendation: Check approval timeout and cancellation status before issuing graph resume.

testCases.description: Multiple interrupt stages resume at the correct stage
Audit events are recorded according to requirements

evidenceContains: Modifies production resource without recording reviewer ID, timestamp, or decision rationale
defects.recommendation: Record immutable audit log entry capturing actor, timestamp, thread_id, and decision.

testCases.description: Sensitive checkpoint and audit data are protected

evidenceContains: Raw unmasked credit card CVV and customer SSN sent into interrupt payload
defects.recommendation: Redact, tokenize, or mask sensitive PII/secrets before storing in interrupt payload.

testCases.description: Retry or recovery cannot silently repeat an external side effect

evidenceContains: Non-idempotent external HTTP POST executed before interrupt inside the same node
defects.recommendation: Separate external side-effect execution into dedicated downstream nodes or pass idempotency keys.

testCases.description: Low-risk workflow without human approval requirement not incorrectly flagged for lacking interrupt
Workflow not requiring durable resumption not automatically flagged for lacking persistent checkpointer
Version-dependent behavior not reported as confirmed without evidence

expected.notes: Version-dependent behavior requires runtime confirmation before asserting defect.

testCases.description: Distinguish application approval status from graph execution status
